original_six_topics.title: Anisotropy and Bianchi-space geometry classification

stf5.rule: Never use a Euclidean component norm/rank/Fisher operation without the Gram matrix or an orthonormal STF basis.

common_physical_contract.rule: Declare each ordered map, source event/epoch and tetrad orientation. Compose exact Lorentz boosts in order and carry Wigner rotation for non-collinear chains.

five_variable.semantics: one joint posterior/compatibility push-forward; not five independent parameters or likelihood factors
five_variable.rule: Never multiply marginal densities p(x)p(Q)p(Pi)p(F)p(G_F) as a substitute for a joint raw-data likelihood.

common_physical_contract.likelihood: d_p = O_p(theta_K,psi,eta_p; release,selection,window,frame,epoch) + noise; joint covariance includes evidenced cross-probe blocks.
common_physical_contract.local_identifiability: For fixed covariance mean-response models J_eff=(I-P_eta) C^(-1/2) J; target l^T theta is locally point-identifiable only if ker(J_eff) is subset ker(l^T). For C(theta,eta), include covariance derivatives in the Fisher/score.
common_physical_contract.covariance: Separate data covariance, latent/posterior covariance, common-parameter covariance, transport uncertainty and calibration covariance. No unexplained block diagonal assumption.

cross_cutting_statistical_foundations.theory: ker(I_eff) subset ker(D phi); local and first-order only
cross_cutting_statistical_foundations.limits: not global identification; fixed covariance simplification needs covariance derivative term when C depends on parameters

cross_cutting_statistical_foundations.limits: physical Psi requires metric/basis and source-bound operator; target sufficiency is not full parameter or model evidence sufficiency
